notes: Born February 19, 1793, St. Clair Township, Allegheny County, PA. Father William Rigdon (from Harford County, MD); youngest of 4 children. Phebe Brooks married June 1820; her sister was wife of Adamson Bentley. 11 children including Nancy Rigdon and John M. Rigdon. Excommunicated, led own church. Died July 14, 1876, Friendship, NY. PA/OH background. No apostle family connections found.
